title: The Crypt Door, Open
text: The crypt door is found open in the morning, swinging a little on its hinges. It was barred from outside, and the bar lies on the steps, unbroken. It has been opened from within. Dust on the stairs shows narrow, bare footprints, coming up.

options.label: Go down and count the dead.

outcomes.text: All the dead are where they were laid. One of them has turned to face the door.
One coffin is empty. The name on it is your founder's.

options.label: Seal the crypt with iron and salt.

outcomes.text: The bars hold. Something taps on them, now and then, politely.

options.label: Leave it open, and set a place at table.

outcomes.text: The House's dead are grateful. Old skills come back to the living in dreams.
The House's dead are hungry. The larder is bare by morning, and the dogs will not come inside.
